changelog: Numbered lists now go to twenty: say 'number eleven' to 'number twenty' (or 'number 11' to 'number 20'; Bengali 'নম্বর এগারো' to 'নম্বর বিশ') while dictating and the numbered item starts on a new line — before, a list with more than ten items broke at item 11 and the rest had to be typed by hand. Works exactly like numbers one to ten. Nothing else changed — it never sends a message.
